title: Concept: Axum rejection detail in a response
description: An Axum rejection message naming the extractor type in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The rejection names the extractor and its expectation, which tells an attacker how the handler parses paths, queries and bodies.
applicability: Deployments that render an Axum rejection message naming the extractor type into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The rejection names the extractor and its expectation, which tells an attacker how the handler parses paths, queries and bodies.
